_comment: Viewer settings. Layers come from the point cloud (data/lidar_points.json, written by site-model/houdini/tools/pack_wide.py) and from the design files; this file only gives display names, order, default visibility and colours. Unknown layers still appear under their own name (grey). Design files site-model/exports/design_<name>.glb load on top of the point cloud (listed in assets/models.json); their layers default to the Design style, visible. Camera values are three.js coordinates: x = east, y = up (m, NAVD88), z = -north, from the site origin E 384580 / N 3768520.

facades._comment: Estimated wall points (site-model/houdini/tools/synth_facades.py), merged into the Buildings points when the LiDAR loads (user, 2026-10-10).

linked._comment: Point cloud, Color = Layer: points coloured by the layer colours below, from the Coolors trending palette F0EAD2 · DDE5B6 · ADC178 · A98467 · 6C584C (Other darkened from Terrain). The clicked object turns the highlight colour unless its layer has "highlight": false (Terrain: too large to light up).

_cloudColor: the first colouring: layer / height / class / intensity

population._comment: Modeled day/night population (site-model/population/prep_population.py): one point per person, size in metres. start = clock at load (hours), speed = simulated seconds per real second. routeColor / neon / neonStrength: the selected person's light trail (neonStrength scales its opacity). whiteCloud: the 'Highlight people' option - grey level (1 = white) and opacity the point cloud fades to (0.5 s). highlightSize: people's size (m) under 'Highlight people'. colors: Okabe-Ito (colour-blind safe), workers #FFD166 and visitors #06D6A0 from Coolors 'Watermelon Sorbet' (user, 2026-10-09).

_mergeLayers: LiDAR layers drawn as another layer in the viewer (user, 2026-10-10): street furniture and the unassigned points join Terrain.
